policies.description: When updating a configuration item, first confirm that the required identifier (configuration_item_id) is supplied and that any fields being modified comply with their individual constraints (e.g., unique serial_number, valid status values). Only after these validations should the update_configuration_item tool be invoked.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.
CI Owner: All CIs must have a recorded owner_id.
CI Status: Only CIs with status = in_use or status = maintenance can be linked to active Incidents. Do not link CIs in status = retired or status = disposed.

policies.description: The status field of a Configuration Item must be one of the allowed enumeration values: in_use, in_stock, maintenance, retired, or disposed.
references: CI Status: Only CIs with status = in_use or status = maintenance can be linked to active Incidents. Do not link CIs in status = retired or status = disposed.
